data.description: Required Agent responsible for administration of the collection. Will have the ability to grant access to shared media storage. Generally the person who can make financial decisions for the collection.
Recommended The agent who is the Arctos Council Member representative for this collection. Will vote in Arctos Working Group Officer elections on behalf of the collection.
Optional for collections publishing to GBIF Agent who will appear as "associatedParty" in EML files generated as DarwinCore metadata.

Required for collections publishing to GBIF Agent who will appear as "creator" in EML files generated as DarwinCore collection metadata. From GBIF publishing documents - the people and organizations who created the resource [...] will be used to auto-generate the resource citation.
Required Agent responsible for managing collection data and access, generally a collections manager. Will be the first point of contact for internal Arctos data issues.
Optional Agent to whom loan requests and reminders are sent.

Required for collections publishing to GBIF Agent who will appear as "metadataProvider" in EML files generated as Darwin Core collection metadata. From GBIF publishing documents - the people and organizations responsible for producing the resource metadata.
Optional Agent to whom technical issues should be addressed. By default, primary programmer is listed.
